subject.title: refactor: prune unsupported OPENCLAW env overrides

question: Should OpenClaw intentionally remove these seven undocumented environment overrides without a deprecation or migration window?
rationale: Environment-surface removal is upgrade-sensitive, and repository-local absence of documentation or callers cannot fully exclude external operator usage.

options.title: Accept bounded removal
options.body: Approve the seven deletions after current-head real-setup proof confirms each canonical replacement works as described.

options.title: Add transition diagnostics
options.body: Temporarily detect removed names and emit actionable guidance toward the canonical variable or setting.

options.title: Retain uncertain overrides
options.body: Keep any name whose external or shipped usage cannot be ruled out and narrow the PR to proven internal-only controls.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded removal
recommendation.body: Approve the seven deletions after current-head real-setup proof confirms each canonical replacement works as described.

likelyOwner.reason: The available evidence identifies steipete as the contributor who performed the complete audit and corrected the previously identified compatibility regression.
